correctness.rationale: Full bounded enumeration: 21 original edges; 84 induced 3-matchings, zero induced 4-matchings; recursion enumerates every exact cover once and returns 416. The 336-element group is the 168 point collineations plus their dualities; it splits all solutions into six orbit sizes 8,16,56,112,112,112. Independent binary-vector and cyclic-Fano reconstruction reproduces the counts and full automorphism orbit partition; exact scripts and outputs embedded.

value.rationale: The Heawood graph is the canonical 3-regular girth-6 cage and Fano incidence graph. The known index value seven says nothing about the multiplicity or symmetry of optimal solutions. The 416 exact solutions and six distinct group orbits (stabilizer orders 42,21,6,3,3,3) are the complete moduli of all minimum induced-matching edge decompositions, a natural benchmark contrasting sharply with the published uniquely decomposable Petersen graph. This is a motivated finite complete classification, not an arbitrary truncated census.
